name: Attention routing eval set
description: Verifies that a request about what needs attention is routed through inbox_agent then classification_agent, and is never answered by inbox_agent alone. This case is judged with evals/routing/test_config.json, which omits tool_trajectory_avg_score and scores only final_response_match_v2 (0.8). Reason: classification_agent's args embed inbox_agent's freeform per-email summary of live inbox contents, which varies run to run regardless of temperature, so an exact tool-trajectory match can never reliably pass here. Instead, the reference final_response asserts the one thing only classification_agent's involvement can produce: emails grouped into priority categories (Urgent, Action Needed, FYI). A response produced by inbox_agent alone would be a flat, uncategorized list, so the LLM judge can distinguish a correctly-routed answer from one that skipped classification even without inspecting the trajectory.
